thread:
alexa_partnerships: Heads-up  BrightWay Analytics can't onboard via AWS Marketplace until merchant account mapping matches the EIN on their PO. Procurement refuses to share EIN until our legal signs their redlined MSA. Stuck in a circular dependency. :weary:

nick_deals: Can you attach the PO and highlight the redlines? I'll escalate to AWS if needed.

alexa_partnerships: PO ref BW-0421. Key snippet they supplied:
```xml
<PO id="BW-0421">
  <Buyer>EIN: 12-3456789</Buyer>
  <Seller>Redwood Inference</Seller>
</PO>
```
Redline changes: Section 8 indemnity carveouts for third-party processors and locale-specific cap modifications. BrightWay's procurement won't sign anything until merchant mapping confirmed.

ops-bot: Created PARTNERS-11234: "BrightWay EIN/merchant mapping + redline". Assigned partnerships/legal/finance. https://tickets.internal/PARTNERS-11234

sanjay_legal: Upload the redline PDF and I'll triage. If edits are narrow we can produce a 1-paragraph counter quickly.

alexa_partnerships: Uploaded: https://files.internal/bw-redline-0421.pdf. Main ask is carveouts for data processors and higher cap in EU jurisdictions.

emily_finance: Finance note: we can do internal provisional billing with a signed EIN attestation, but AWS partner ops requires either the EIN on the PO or a notarized verification to map merchant.

nick_deals: @aws-pm is there any flexible path on AWS side for merchant mapping? Manual override?

aws-pm: We can request partner-ops to perform manual mapping in exceptions but they require either (A) notarized EIN verification or (B) a signed agreement showing the legal entity matches. Partner-ops approved cases are very limited. I can queue it if we get signed counter + attestation.

ravi_engineering: If AWS gives provisional approval, we can push a sandbox listing and test SKU in ~48hrs to unblock integration testing.

alexa_partnerships: Two asks: @sanjay_legal draft a tight counter preserving our indemnity posture but addressing processor carveouts; @emily_finance confirm whether a signed attestation will let us invoice internally while AWS does mapping.

sanjay_legal: Taking a pass now. If it's small I'll send a counter by EOD PT. If they insist on broad changes we escalate to GC.

emily_finance: Confirmed: signed EIN attestation helps our internal process but AWS partner-ops will still want the EIN on the PO or a notary for mapping.

nick_deals: Plan B: ask BrightWay to sign our standard PO for an initial pilot while their legal negotiations continue for enterprise. Would procurement accept that?

alexa_partnerships: Their procurement policy says no signing without merchant mapping. They offered a Pro Forma invoice, but AWS won't accept that for partner mapping.

ops-bot: Reminder: kickoff call scheduled with BrightWay procurement 2026-04-22 10:00 PDT. Calendar invite sent.

sanjay_legal: Draft counter uploaded. It preserves our indemnity and adds a narrowly scoped processor carveout. Sending to BrightWay now and requesting a signed EIN attestation.

alexa_partnerships: Sent to BrightWay procurement with ask for signed attestation. Waiting on reply.

aws-pm: If BrightWay returns signed counter + attestation I'll escalate to partner-ops to do manual mapping and prioritize the case.

emily_finance: If we get both docs, I'll prepare internal invoice mapping and flag for expedited settlement. AWS mapping still needed for marketplace billing.

nick_deals: I'll join the 10:00 call to push AWS PM and coordinate next steps. Thanks team.

alexa_partnerships: Closing loop until the procurement call. Drop any incoming docs into this thread. :pray: :eyes:
